name: 46327 · Hammond, IN
findings: ZIP 46327 (Hammond) has 21 nonprofit organizations. 9 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 6 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (44% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46327 (Hammond) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 46327 (Hammond) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 40% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 29% of all organizations here have no identified type.
